Conduits. Put the key in, and ya can pull the shinies out. Trick is, you gotta wait to open. Somethin' happens to the Conduit before you can pull the goods? You don't get the goods. Ever. Also, the bleeders Alad sold the tech to will try to kill you.|[[Little Duck]] introductory transmission}} '''Disruption''' is an Endless [[Mission]] type introduced in {{ver|25}}, tasking the Tenno with recovering items from conduits, asset security systems which [[Alad V]] has marketed and sold across the system. Similar to [[Mobile Defense]], the squad must fight high-ranking enemies to loot a conduit key and activate a terminal, then defend it from a Demo unit that tries to destroy that terminal. The Disruption Node on [[Ganymede]], [[Jupiter]] is only accessible after completing the [[Natah (Quest)|Natah]] quest. The node on [[Apollo]], [[Lua]] is only accessible after completing [[The War Within]] quest. The node on [[Armatus]], [[Deimos]] requires [[The Deadlock Protocol]] and [[Whispers in the Walls]] quests. {{clr}}{{tocright}} ==Rewards== Disruption missions reward up to 1500 objective [[affinity]], based on mission level, for each conduit which is successfully defended (usually by killing the associated Demo). Disruption does not follow the traditional 'AABC' rotation for endless missions. The reward tier is determined by both round progression and round performance, i.e. the number of conduits successfully defended.
